article_title: US-funded vaccine trial on babies cancelled in Guinea-Bissau after uproar

tasks.prompt: What is the article's central focus?
options: A hepatitis B vaccine trial involving newborns in Guinea-Bissau was cancelled amid ethical, legal and political controversy.
Guinea-Bissau has stopped all childhood vaccinations permanently.
The WHO has withdrawn its recommendation for hepatitis B vaccination at birth.
A completed trial proved that the vaccine increased infant mortality.
tasks.correct_answer: A hepatitis B vaccine trial involving newborns in Guinea-Bissau was cancelled amid ethical, legal and political controversy.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה מדוע ניסוי מתוכנן בחיסון הפטיטיס B ביילודים בוטל בעקבות מחלוקת אתית, משפטית ופוליטית.

tasks.prompt: How was the proposed trial designed?
options: All 14,000 newborns would receive two doses at birth.
Half of 14,000 newborns would receive the vaccine shortly after birth and half would not.
Only adults with hepatitis B would participate.
The study would compare vaccines in Denmark and the United States.
tasks.correct_answer: Half of 14,000 newborns would receive the vaccine shortly after birth and half would not.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התכנון כלל 14,000 יילודים: מחציתם היו אמורים לקבל את החיסון סמוך ללידה ומחציתם לא.

tasks.prompt: What does “withhold” mean in the criticism that the trial would withhold a vaccine?
options: Improve the vaccine's storage
Publish the study protocol
Deliberately not give something that could be provided
Administer an extra dose
tasks.correct_answer: Deliberately not give something that could be provided
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המילה withhold פירושה להימנע במכוון ממתן דבר שניתן היה לספק, במקרה זה חיסון.

tasks.prompt: Why did the WHO representative call the design unethical?
options: The vaccine had never been used anywhere.
The study included too few researchers.
Guinea-Bissau had already eliminated hepatitis B.
It would deny some newborns a proven intervention recommended at birth.
tasks.correct_answer: It would deny some newborns a proven intervention recommended at birth.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: נציג ארגון הבריאות העולמי טען שאין זה אתי למנוע מחלק מהיילודים התערבות מוכחת שמומלצת בלידה.

tasks.prompt: What did the SDU dean say about whether the trial had begun?
options: It had not started, no babies had been enrolled and no research vaccinations had been given.
It had finished before the government learned about it.
Half the planned newborns had already received a shot.
The trial had moved from Guinea-Bissau to Denmark.
tasks.correct_answer: It had not started, no babies had been enrolled and no research vaccinations had been given.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: דיקן SDU אמר שהניסוי כלל לא התחיל, שלא גויסו תינוקות ושלא ניתנו חיסונים במסגרת המחקר.

tasks.prompt: In this context, what does “neocolonialism” refer to?
options: A new vaccination schedule for European countries
The concern that powerful foreign institutions impose risks on a poorer country that they might not accept at home
The transfer of vaccine factories to Guinea-Bissau
A policy requiring every study to be funded locally
tasks.correct_answer: The concern that powerful foreign institutions impose risks on a poorer country that they might not accept at home
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המונח מתאר את החשש שגופים זרים חזקים מטילים סיכונים על אוכלוסייה במדינה ענייה, סיכונים שלא היו מקבלים במדינה עשירה.

tasks.prompt: Explain why vaccination at birth matters for hepatitis B according to the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את סיכון ההדבקה, חשיבות התזמון והשלכות הזיהום בילדות.
expected_points: Babies can be exposed during childbirth if their mothers are infected.
Guinea-Bissau currently vaccinates at six weeks, which is less effective than a birth dose.
Infection acquired in infancy is especially likely to become chronic.
Chronic infection can lead to liver failure or liver cancer and can be fatal.

tasks.prompt: Why did the absence of a publicly available protocol increase concern about the proposed trial?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד שקיפות מאפשרת לבדוק תכנון, סיכונים, אישורים והגנה על המשתתפים.
expected_points: The WHO representative could not examine the study's detailed methods when questions arose.
A protocol would clarify who received or did not receive the vaccine and how risks were managed.
Public scrutiny is especially important when vulnerable newborns are involved.
The lack of accessible information added to uncertainty about ethical approval and government authorisation.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the proposed study, the ethical objections, and why it did not proceed in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מבנה הניסוי, המלצת WHO, עמדת ממשלת גינאה־ביסאו, טענת SDU ומצב הביצוע בפועל.
expected_points: The US-funded study proposed enrolling 14,000 newborns, giving a birth-dose hepatitis B vaccine to half and withholding it from half.
Critics and the WHO argued that withholding a proven recommended intervention in a high-prevalence country was unethical.
Guinea-Bissau had prohibited such child trials and its health minister denied authorising the revised study.
SDU said its own ethics committee approved the project but acknowledged that local authorisation was separately required.
The university said the trial never started and no babies were enrolled.

tasks.prompt: Draft a short ethics checklist for researchers planning a vaccine study involving newborns.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח רשימת בדיקה המבוססת על הסוגיות בכתבה, לא ייעוץ רפואי אישי.
expected_points: Confirm that the study does not unnecessarily withhold a proven standard intervention.
Obtain transparent, independent ethical review and valid authorisation in the host country.
Publish or make the protocol available for scrutiny.
Explain risks, benefits and protections for vulnerable participants.
Respect local government decisions and ensure informed consent procedures.
Consider whether the same design would be acceptable in a wealthier country.
